description: Maine’s woods, waters, and outdoor traditions are an important part of who we are. Hunting, fishing, snowmobiling, hiking, and spending time outdoors aren’t just recreational activities—they’re traditions passed down through generations and an important part of our rural economy.Protecting our outdoor heritage means conserving the natural resources that make these traditions possible while respecting the responsible sportsmen, landowners, clubs, and volunteers who have cared for them for generat
title: Preserve Our Outdoor Heritage
